claim: On May 22, 2024 the Amazon OpenSearch Service documentation history recorded that OpenSearch Service now supports running queries directly on data stored in Amazon S3, without needing to ingest the data into an OpenSearch index.
question: Since when can OpenSearch Service query data in S3 directly?

qualifiers.scope: OpenSearch Service direct queries on Amazon S3
qualifiers.condition: The brief expected zero-ETL with S3 on 2024-05-22; the history row calls this feature direct queries.
